topic: Pick a shared coffee subscription for the office kitchen

scenario.topic: Pick a shared coffee subscription for the office kitchen
scenario.opening_question: What matters most to us when picking a coffee subscription for the office kitchen?

options.name: Single-Origin Medium Roast Subscription
options.upside: Consistent flavor profile with high-quality beans sourced from one region
options.tradeoff: Less variety, may get repetitive over time
options.concern: Some team members prefer lighter or darker roasts
options.best_for: Those prioritizing flavor consistency and quality

options.name: Mixed Roast Variety Pack Subscription
options.upside: Offers diverse roast levels to suit different tastes
options.tradeoff: Ground coffee may lose freshness faster than whole bean
options.concern: Requires more frequent restocking and storage space

options.name: Organic Fair-Trade Blend Subscription
options.upside: Ethically sourced with environmental and social benefits
options.tradeoff: Blend flavor may be less distinctive than single-origin
options.concern: Some may find the taste less bold or complex
options.best_for: Those prioritizing ethical sourcing and sustainability

options.name: Instant Coffee Premium Subscription
options.upside: Fast and easy preparation, minimal cleanup
options.tradeoff: Flavor quality generally lower than fresh brewed coffee
options.concern: May not satisfy coffee enthusiasts seeking rich taste
options.best_for: Teams needing speed and convenience over flavor

shared_context: The office has exactly 3 regular coffee drinkers
Monthly budget for coffee subscription is capped at $50
Goal is to have a convenient, quality coffee supply for daily use

personas.name: Emeka
personas.background: I appreciate high-quality, consistent coffee that highlights unique regional flavors for our office.
personas.private_goal: I want a subscription that delivers consistent, high-quality whole bean coffee with a medium roast profile.

agenda.reason: state one grounded reason for the initial preference
ask about a practical constraint that could affect the choice
compare the preferred option with a realistic alternative
look for a workable compromise the group could accept

personas.private_goal: I want a subscription that offers diverse roast levels and frequent deliveries to keep coffee fresh and exciting.
